brief: The name of the native module method that was called. Only applies to React Native.

apply_scrubbing.reason: Native module and method names are app-defined identifiers, but scrubbing them would make the call attribution unusable

deprecation.reason: Replaced by the `react_native.*` namespace, which also covers native module calls made over the Old Architecture bridge, which are not TurboModules

changelog.description: Added turbo_module.method and deprecated it in favor of react_native.module.method
